BIS's 13 May 2025 release lists licence requirements for Malaysia and Thailand, but no published rule was found; Bloomberg (Jul 2025) called it a draft, later reported shelved (Aug 2026). Malaysia's own Strategic Trade Permit applies since 14 Jul 2025; ART (Oct 2025) commits it to align with US export controls.

Same as Malaysia: named in BIS 13 May 2025 release and the July 2025 draft, no rule found in force; draft reportedly shelved Aug 2026. Bangkok firm reportedly tied to the 2026 Supermicro diversion case.
